Package index

Designing the trial

Lay out the plots: strip or stacked, randomised or systematic.

make_trial_design()
Lay out an on-farm strip trial

Planning the sample

How many point samples the target precision needs, and where they go.

kriging_sample_interval()
How far apart should the samples be, and how many are needed?
place_point_samples()
Choose where to put point samples

Preparing the data

Getting an irregular yield-monitor cloud onto the lattice a spatial model needs, and interpolating the sparse layer onto the same grid.

grid_dense_layer()
Aggregate an irregular dense layer onto a regular lattice
krige_point_samples()
Krige sparse point-source samples onto a target grid

Checking the point layer

What the samples say about the scale of the variation, and whether they are dense enough to reconstruct their own surface.

ofe_variogram()
Empirical and fitted variogram of a point-sampled variable
print(<ofe_variogram>)
Report a fitted variogram
plot(<ofe_variogram>)
Plot an empirical variogram and the model fitted to it
cv_krige_surface()
Cross-validate a kriged point-source surface

Fitting the spatial model

A REML engine with ASReml-style residual structures, written in base R, plus the tests and predicted means that go with it.

fit_ofe()
Fit a spatial mixed model without asreml
ofe_control()
Control parameters for fit_ofe()
summary(<ofe_fit>)
Summarise a fitted ofe_fit
wald_tests()
Wald tests of the fixed-effect terms
ofe_means()
Predicted means for a fixed term

Reporting the means

Predicted means with least significant differences and the a/b/c letters a trial report prints beside them.

ofe_lsd()
Predicted means with LSD letters
compact_letters()
Compact letter display from any set of pairwise comparisons

Finding pseudo-environments

Cutting the trial into zones — across its length from the yield pattern, or into contiguous regions from elevation and soil — and writing the residual structure that follows from them.

partition_pseudo_env()
Derive pseudo-environments from the spatial pattern of the dense layer
partition_paddock()
Partition a paddock into contiguous zones from environmental covariates
adaptive_residual()
Build a residual structure that matches the realised geometry

Estimating the treatment effect

The two integration strategies, the free baseline they are judged against, and a model-agnostic way to read the contrasts out.

compare_integration()
Compare an integrated analysis against the free baseline
fit_integrated_kriged()
Fit a treatment model using a kriged point-source covariate
fit_integrated_joint()
Fit a joint bivariate spatial model for dense and point-source data
extract_fixed_effects()
Extract a tidy table of fixed-effect estimates

Simulating trials

A paddock whose truth is known, a tidy lattice for quick tests, and the awkward shape a real harvester produces for testing the full pipeline.

simulate_paddock()
Simulate a paddock, its covariate layers, and a trial in it
simulate_ofe_trial()
Simulate a synthetic OFE strip trial with a sparse point-source covariate
simulate_yield_monitor()
Simulate a trial as a yield monitor actually records it

Looking at it

Maps and diagnostics. A trial is a thing in a paddock, and most mistakes in one are visible on a map and invisible in a table.

ofe_map()
Map a variable over the trial
plot(<ofe_design>)
Draw the trial layout
plot(<ofe_zones>)
Draw a zone map
plot(<ofe_fit>)
Diagnostic plots for a fitted spatial model
ofe_palette()
Colours used by the package's plots
